## Description

Review the drafted ADR-001 (stack), ADR-003 (country isolation), ADR-004 (BFF), ADR-005 (tenant isolation/RLS) and ADR-006 (immutable signed records) and move them to Accepted. Superseded stack statements in the Build Plan and Azure Architecture design pages are listed in docs/01-prd/source-conflicts.md and must not be implemented.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** ADR-001, 003, 004, 005 and 006 have status Accepted with date and decider.
- [ ] **AC2.** Each ADR lists the alternatives rejected and why (NestJS, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, AKS in P0–P6).
- [ ] **AC3.** docs/01-prd/source-conflicts.md rows C-01…C-07 reference the accepted ADRs.
- [ ] **AC4.** A short note is sent to the design project owner to update the Build Plan and Azure Architecture pages (PRD v2 finding "CHANGE").

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
